title: Vegan Crunchy Japanese Bowl
description: A crunchy and flavorful vegan bowl inspired by Japanese cuisine. This recipe is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Crunchy Sesame Topping
ingredients.notes: crushed Japanese sesame seeds and crunchy rice

ingredients.name: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients.notes: mix of broccoli, carrots, and bell peppers

instructions: Cook the sushi rice according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the teriyaki sauce over medium heat. Add the roasted vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked sushi rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the rice mixture to a bowl and top with sliced avocado, pickled ginger, and crunchy sesame topping.
